Introduction

Lattice is a fast, local toolchain for managing monorepos. Point it at a repo with projects in more than one language, and it builds, tests, and runs them for you with one command.

Because it caches every result, a second build only redoes the parts that changed. And because everything runs on your machine, you never wait on a remote service to get work done.

What you get

  • Builds that finish sooner. Unchanged work comes back from cache instead of running again.
  • One command for the whole repo. Every project builds the same way, whatever language it’s written in.
  • The same result everywhere. Lattice pins each project’s tools, so a fresh clone builds the same on your machine and in CI.
